    1. RECEIVER

Interface ImplicitCallTarget

All Known Implementing Classes:
ImplicitCallTarget.Direct, ImplicitCallTarget.Indirect
public sealed interface ImplicitCallTarget permits ImplicitCallTarget.Direct, ImplicitCallTarget.Indirect
A method that a call invokes implicitly. Positions denote the values of the call that owns the target: RECEIVER is the receiver of the call, other positions are argument indices.

    Targets that depend on an earlier call on the value at the given position in the same method, e.g. the Runnable that was passed to the constructor of a Thread before start() is called on it.
